answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The harbor cap is policed at intake and grove reveals the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a basalt tag. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
